text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин rises above her powerful
classic
and senior competitors and
triumphs at the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her rivals, the audience, and I—we all
cheer for
her as one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her small stature, she leaves the
biggest
mark of anyone at the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With an undeniably beaming smile,
Нарита Таисин
stands atop the winner's
circle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
